notes: Available machines, cable stations, free weights, and gym-specific equipment quirks. The AI agent MUST consult this list when designing or modifying workout routines to ensure suggested exercises can actually be performed.

available_machines.name: Smith Machine
available_machines.notes: Counterbalanced bar (near-zero initial resistance). Ratio: 1:1 direct vertical track. Plate-loaded, min increment 5kg total (2x2.5kg plates, no 1.25kg plates available). Bench is movable and fully removable (incline notch #11 or #12). Hevy mapping: flat press is 'Bench Press (Smith Machine)', calf raise is 'Standing Calf Raise (Smith)'. Hip thrust possible ('Hip Thrust (Smith Machine)') but dedicated machine preferred.

available_machines.name: Chest Press (Machine)
available_machines.notes: Pin-loaded stack: 5kg to 100kg in 5kg increments. Mechanical advantage ratio: 1:1. Dual grip options: horizontal and vertical/neutral (currently defaults to horizontal). Setup: optional rolled mat placed behind the back for enhanced ROM/scapular positioning. Hevy mapping: both horizontal and neutral grips log under 'Chest Press (Machine)' (specify grip in exercise notes).

available_machines.name: Seated Shoulder Press (Machine)
available_machines.notes: Pin-loaded stack: 5kg to 100kg in 5kg increments. Mechanical advantage ratio: 1:1. Grip options: horizontal (pronated) or neutral. Cues: keep elbows slightly forward, drive through wrists. Hevy mapping: both grip orientations log under 'Seated Shoulder Press (Machine)'.

available_machines.name: Leg Press (Machine)
available_machines.notes: 45-degree incline sled. User logs ONLY loaded plates weight (ignoring ~20kg starting sled pre-load). Effective mechanical advantage ratio: ~0.71:1 (sin 45 deg) along the incline plane. Plate-loaded: plates available in 20kg, 15kg, 10kg, and 5kg. Footplate allows narrow/wide stances and calf presses ('Calf Press (Machine)').

available_machines.name: Lying Leg Curl (Machine)
available_machines.notes: Pin-loaded weight stack: 5kg to 80kg in 5kg increments. Mechanical advantage ratio: 1:1 direct cam. Prone lying position with handles. Hevy muscle mapping: primary 'hamstrings', secondary 'calves'.

available_machines.name: Leg Extension (Machine)
available_machines.notes: Pin-loaded weight stack: 5kg to 80kg in 5kg increments. Mechanical advantage ratio: 1:1 direct cam. Seated position with side stability handles. Hevy mapping: bilateral is 'Leg Extension (Machine)', unilateral is 'Single Leg Extensions'.

available_machines.name: Hip Thrust Machine
available_machines.notes: Plate-loaded station with belt strap harness. Uses standard Olympic weight plates (20kg, 15kg, 10kg, 5kg). Pivoting lever arm (~1:1 ratio). User logs loaded plate weight. Hevy muscle mapping: primary 'glutes', secondary 'hamstrings', 'quadriceps', 'adductors'.

available_machines.name: Hyperextension / 45° Back Extension Bench
available_machines.notes: 45-degree angle bench with adjustable leg/footplate position. Resistance is provided by handheld Olympic weight plates (5kg, 10kg, 15kg, 20kg) held against chest. Hevy mapping: 'Back Extension (Weighted Hyperextension)' or 'Back Extension (Hyperextension)' (specify erector vs glute-rounded-back bias in exercise notes).

available_machines.name: Pec Deck / Rear Delt Fly Machine
available_machines.notes: Single dual-function combo unit with pin-regulated swing arms. Stack: 5kg to 100kg in 5kg increments. Mechanical advantage ratio: 1:1. Settings: Butterfly uses arm pin #1 or #2 (facing forward). Reverse Fly uses arm pin #5 (sitting facing the pad in opposite direction, initiate with scapular protraction). Hevy mapping: 'Butterfly (Pec Deck)' (primary: chest) and 'Rear Delt Reverse Fly (Machine)' (primary: shoulders [rear delts], secondary: upper_back).

available_machines.name: Dual Cable Functional Trainer
available_machines.notes: Symmetric dual-stack cable crossover / functional trainer. Mechanical advantage ratio: 2:1 per side. Pin-loaded in 5kg plate steps. Fully adjustable vertical pulleys (bottom to top). Attachments: straight bar, V-bar, single rope, double ropes (short & long), single loop stirrup handles, 4-loop multi-grip strap. Hevy mapping note: both 'Triceps Pushdown' and 'Triceps Pressdown' exist in Hevy; woodchoppers map to 'Cable Twist (Up to down)' / 'Cable Twist (Down to up)'.

available_machines.name: Seated Cable Row (Station)
typical_exercises: Seated Cable Row - Bar Wide Grip
available_machines.notes: Dedicated seated row station with footplates. Mechanical advantage ratio: 1:1. Pin-loaded stack in 5kg increments. Compatible with close-grip V-bar, neutral handles, and wide straight/lat bar. Hevy mapping: primary muscle is 'upper_back', secondary 'lats', 'biceps', 'forearms' (plus 'traps' on wide grip).

available_machines.name: Lat Pulldown (Station)
available_machines.notes: Dedicated seated lat pulldown station with adjustable thigh pads. Mechanical advantage ratio: 1:1. Pin-loaded stack in 5kg increments. Attachments available: wide lat bar, neutral grip attachments (wide to close/Mag grips), close-grip V-bar. Hevy mapping: neutral/Mag grips log under 'Lat Pulldown (Cable)' or 'Lat Pulldown - Close Grip (Cable)' (specify grip in exercise notes).

available_machines.name: Assisted Pull-Up & Dip Machine
available_machines.notes: Counterbalance knee-pad platform. Ratio: 1:1 counterbalance (each 5kg pin reduces effective bodyweight by 5kg). 5kg increments. Kneeling platform folds down for unassisted bodyweight pull-ups, chin-ups, dips, and hanging knee/leg raises. Multi-grip pull-up handles and parallel dip bars. Hevy mapping: uses 'bodyweight_assisted' type for '(Assisted)' variants and 'reps_only' for unassisted variants.

available_machines.name: Hip Adduction / Abduction Machine
available_machines.notes: Single combo unit; switch rotating leg pad holders for adduction (inner thigh) vs abduction (glute medius / outer hip). Pin-loaded stack: 5kg to 100kg in 5kg increments. Mechanical advantage ratio: 1:1.

available_machines.name: Power Cage / Squat Rack & Landmine Station
available_machines.notes: Full power cage equipped with adjustable J-hooks and safety spotter arms. Uses standard 20kg Olympic barbell and Olympic plates (20kg, 15kg, 10kg, 5kg, 2.5kg). Direct 1:1 ratio for barbell lifts. Includes ground pivot sleeve (landmine attachment) compatible with single-handle, double-handle, and T-bar row attachments (~0.5:1 effective lever ratio on landmine). Movable bench can be rolled in for bench pressing.

available_machines.name: Fixed Barbells Rack (Straight & EZ-Bars)
available_machines.notes: Fixed barbells from 5kg to 30kg in 5kg increments (5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30kg). Both bar profiles available: standard straight bars and EZ-curl bars. Mechanical advantage ratio: 1:1. Hevy mapping: EZ-bar curl is 'EZ Bar Biceps Curl' (no hyphen, plural Biceps); EZ-bar skullcrushers/extensions log under 'Skullcrusher (Barbell)' / 'Triceps Extension (Barbell)'.

available_machines.name: Dumbbell Racks & Adjustable Benches
available_machines.notes: Two dumbbell racks: Rack 1 (1kg to 10kg in 1kg increments), Rack 2 (2.5kg to 40kg in 2.5kg increments). Multiple adjustable benches (flat, incline up to 90 degrees). Mechanical advantage ratio: 1:1.

available_machines.name: Preacher Curl Stand / Bench
available_machines.notes: Seated angled arm-support preacher bench with bar rack hooks. Compatible with fixed EZ-curl bars (5-30kg), straight barbells (5-30kg), or dumbbells. Ratio: 1:1. Hevy mapping: both straight and EZ-bar preacher curls log under 'Preacher Curl (Barbell)' (specify EZ-bar in exercise notes).

available_machines.name: Trap Bar / Hex Bar Station
available_machines.notes: 20kg Olympic trap bar / hex bar with dual high and low handle grips. Loaded with standard Olympic plates (20kg, 15kg, 10kg, 5kg, 2.5kg). Direct 1:1 ratio. Hevy mapping: trap bar deadlift is 'Deadlift (Trap bar)' (lowercase 'bar'); trap bar shrugs log under 'Shrug (Barbell)' with trap bar noted.

available_machines.name: Functional Accessories & Mobility Station
available_machines.notes: Accessories: Standard set of kettlebells; loop and long resistance bands; yoga blocks (deficits, ROM targets); foot triangular squat wedges / slant blocks (heel elevation for quad-dominant squats, split squats, and calf raises). Hevy mapping: heel-elevated squats/split squats log under the primary barbell/dumbbell squat template with 'heel elevated on wedge' in notes.

free_weights_and_bars.name: Trap Bar / Hex Bar
free_weights_and_bars.notes: 20kg bar + Olympic weight plates. Used for Trap Bar Deadlifts.

free_weights_and_bars.name: Olympic Barbells & Plates
free_weights_and_bars.notes: Standard 20kg bars, curl bars, Olympic plates.

free_weights_and_bars.name: Dumbbells
free_weights_and_bars.notes: Full dumbbell rack. Used for Bulgarian Split Squats, Incline Rows, Lateral Raises, Curls.

unavailable_or_lacking: Hack Squat machine (use Leg Press or Smith Squat instead)
